{{Top|leg}}
'''Garrison Base Bakura''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-455 modular garrison|garrison base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Located south of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], it had a complement of eight hundred [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], two hundred [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] support personnel, and two thousand [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]].
